scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:tools && npm run test:server
scripts.test:web: node --test smpl_render/tests/*.test.js smpl_web_viewer/tests/*.test.js label/tests/*.test.js smpl_edit/tests/*.test.js pcd_label/tests/*.test.js kpt_label/tests/*.test.js tests/smpl_viewer_local_data.test.js
scripts.test:tools: PYTHONPATH=smpl_web_viewer python3 -m unittest discover -s smpl_web_viewer/tests -p 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s kpt_label/tools -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.serve:label: node smpl_web_viewer/tools/static_server.mjs --root . --port 5175
